title: Parity vectors and paradoxical sequences in the accelerated Collatz map
summary: This note studies parity vectors and paradoxical sequences in the accelerated Collatz iteration $T(n) = (3n+1)/2$ for $n$ odd, $T(n) = n/2$ for $n$ even. Building on Rozier and Terracol (arXiv:2502.00948, 2025), Terras (1976), Lagarias (1985), and Tao (2019), we prove three theorems and add one numerical observation. The first is a sharp finitary form of Terras's parity-vector density; the second is a closed-form analytic count of paradoxical $Ω_k(n)$ for each fixed length $k$.
